meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Recommended Supplier 1" empty
gaps: The catalog cannot guarantee the exact setup of the named RFQ with 10 units and Vendor B beyond the prepared event's single line item and configured vendor.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot guarantee the exact setup of the named RFQ with 10 units and Vendor B beyond the prepared event's single line item and configured vendor.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding screen to allocate the bid before creating the proposal.
Allocate the available line item to the case's named Vendor B.
Confirm the line item and vendor are allocated before creating the proposal.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: On the proposal page, fill every required proposal-form field except Recommended Supplier 1, click Submit Proposal, and leave the page showing the required-field validation for Recommended Supplier 1 without submitting the proposal

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately leaving the target field empty, then submit to trigger the validation.
Assert that the omitted supplier field is highlighted as required.
